title: feat(plugin-chatbot): the chat draws a confirm card for a package removal
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-support-ai"} -->
_Requested by **Yibo Wang** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01BVUyyPie8gHwoPM18iABwB?thread=cmsg_01BVUyyPie8gHwoPM18iABwBGKmJknJnqwh1BakWHY3yHx)_

Fixes #31025

Clause-②: yes (widening)
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：AI 聊天里，助手发起「删除软件包」时，不再只显示通用的「批准 / 拒绝」和一段 JSON，而是一张确认卡：列出每个对象及其记录数（草稿对象写明尚无数据表，数不出来的写明无法获取，都不显示成 0）、其他元数据按类型计数、总记录数（有对象数不出来时注明总数偏少），并在删表时用红字写明表会被永久删除、不进回收站；保留数据时写明表和记录都保留。批准后卡片写明已删除或部分删除（几项未能移除）。
- 为什么改：这是 #31025 的第二半（第一半 Studio 删除对话框已在 #31193 合并）。cloud 的 `delete_package` 工具（cloud#3686）已经返回 `packageRemoval` 清单，聊天却画不出来，cloud#3656（p1）卡在这里。
- 风险与回滚：只改前端渲染和文案；批准 / 拒绝仍走原来的 `/api/v1/ai/pending-actions/:id/{approve,reject}`，卡片不回传任何东西。没有 `packageRemoval` 的结果完全不受影响。回滚即还原本 PR。
- 先看：`ui/packages/plugin-chatbot/src/mapMessages.ts`（`detectPackageRemoval`：`rows` 缺失保持缺失、不当 0）、`ui/packages/plugin-chatbot/src/ChatbotEnhanced.tsx`（`data-testid="package-removal"` 那一块，`data === 'dropped'` 才画永久删除行）、`ui/packages/app-shell/src/console/ai/AiChatPage.tsx`（标签接线和刷新后的复原）。
- 两分钟验证：`pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run packages/plugin-chatbot/src/__tests__/recordWrite-3565.test.ts packages/plugin-chatbot/src/__tests__/ChatbotEnhanced.recordWriteCard-3565.test.tsx`，预期 39 个用例全绿，其中「the package-removal card (objectstack#31025)」一组 10 个。
- 需要你做的：无，席位落地。

## What changes

The chat draws a confirm card for cloud's `delete_package` pending action, built on the shape the `repo:cloud` lane put on #31025 (comment 6754040588, read at cloud `d6288d27`; tool from cloud#3686) and nothing beyond it.

- **Parser** (`ui/packages/plugin-chatbot/src/mapMessages.ts`): `PackageRemoval` / `PackageRemovalObject` and `detectPackageRemoval(result)`, beside `detectSampleDataCleanup` and built on `detectPendingApproval`. An envelope without `pendingActionId` or without a `packageRemoval` object is not a card, so a refusal (`success: false`) and the MCP door's `status: 'confirmation_required'` draw none. Counts are normalised to non-negative whole numbers; an object's `rows` that is absent (or not a usable number) stays absent, never `0`; `totalRows` falls back to the sum of counted rows. The live mapper carries it on the tool invocation like `sampleDataCleanup`, and `AiChatPage`'s hydration mapper lifts it too, so the card survives a reload. `detectPackageRemovedResult` reads the approved outcome (`PackageRemovedResult`: `removed` or `partial` with the `failed` count).
- **Card** (`ChatbotEnhanced.tsx`, a `packageRemoval` block beside the `sampleDataCleanup` one, above the generic Approve / Deny strip, which stays the decision): the package label in the title; each object with its record count, a draft saying it has no table and an uncounted object saying its count is unavailable (neither draws a number); the other items by type from `items`; the total, plus a line when `uncountedObjects > 0` that the total leaves those objects out; when `data === 'dropped'` a destructive line that the tables are dropped permanently and do not go to the recycle bin, and when `data === 'kept'` a line that the tables and their records are kept. The raw pending payload stays hidden, as for the sample-data card.
- **Outcome**: measured first. On an approved pending action the chat's generic decision strip says "Approved — action executed." whatever the result (`useHitlInChat` sets that text and keeps the result aside), so a partial removal would read as fully executed. The card now adds one line: removed, or partly removed with the number of items not removed. Nothing larger.
- **Labels**: `packageRemoval*Label` props with English defaults, wired from `AiChatPage` to new `console.ai.packageRemoval*` keys in every `@object-ui/i18n` pack (zh-Hant through `gen:zh-hant`). Wording reuses Expected 1's studio strings where the fact is the same ("Record count unavailable", the permanent-drop sentence); type names come from the same `translateMetadataType` table the Studio Delete package dialog uses.

No server, `packages/spec/**` or cloud change: the payload is a tool-result string the chat already parses.

## Tests

Both in the existing cloud#3565 harness files, each as a new top-level `describe` (AGENTS.md: a new pin for a component that already has a shared harness goes into that file).

- `recordWrite-3565.test.ts`: a full envelope maps (bare and persisted-wrapper shapes); an absent `rows` stays absent while a real `0` stays `0`; no `pendingActionId`, no `packageRemoval`, a refusal and `confirmation_required` each map to undefined; defensive normalisation; the live mapper lifts it beside the pending id; the outcome parser reads `removed` / `partial` and nothing else.
- `ChatbotEnhanced.recordWriteCard-3565.test.tsx` (real mapper, real component): objects, counts, items and total render and the generic decision fires `onToolApprove('c1', true)`; a draft and an uncounted object draw no digit; the permanent line renders for `dropped` (CONTROL: `kept` draws the kept line and no permanent line); the short-total line renders only when `uncountedObjects > 0` (CONTROL: all counted, no line); a refusal draws no card; an approved removal says removed, a partial one names the failed count, a rejection draws no outcome.

## Acceptance notes

- `Clause-②: yes (widening)`, measured on the diff: the published `@object-ui/i18n` catalogue gains the `console.ai.packageRemoval*` keys and changes none; `@object-ui/plugin-chatbot` gains exports and optional props. The claim wrote `Clause-②: yes` without an arm; the order named `(widening)`.
- `@object-ui/app-shell` is private, so the changeset names `@object-ui/plugin-chatbot` and `@object-ui/i18n` only.
- eslint over the touched source files: 0 errors; `index.tsx` carries one more `react-refresh/only-export-components` warning than on `main` (the new `detectPackageRemoval` re-export, the same rule its siblings already trip).
- Neither `plugin-chatbot`'s README nor `content/docs/frontend/` documents the sibling chat cards (record write, sample-data cleanup), so no doc page gained a section here.
- No browser leg: the agent runtime behind `/api/v1/ai/**` is not in this repository, so the card is pinned through the real mapper and component; the staging reading is cloud#3656's done-when.
